Flood Insurance Data

Download the data

Per-county aggregates computed from FEMA OpenFEMA and NOAA NCEI: policy units, cost spread, full-risk gap, claims, average paid claim, share closed without payment, share of paid dollars outside the high-risk zone, NFIP take-up, and NOAA flood events (1996–2025). Blank = not available for that county.
